text: Tonight: if your child has had a difficult day (a problem at the nursery, a change in routine), give him a little more time before you expect him to calm down. Don’t ask, ‘What happened?’ right away.

review_defects.english: give him a little more time
review_defects.why: The Arabic says 'give him longer time' without the qualifier 'a little'. The English adds 'a little', softening the instruction slightly.
